about_the_game:
Note for current build:

·       Progress resets whenever you quit to the desktop.

·       Only 3 characters and 1 region are available.

The game is still in Early Access, so the description will change as it is developed. Please keep in mind that this does mean that some mechanics will get removed and/or added. Please adjust your expectations accordingly.

Euberis has stolen the crown jewel and escaped into the labyrinth. The crown jewels are scattered across the land. Enter the labyrinths, defeat the Monsters who hold the jewels, confront Euberis and return the crown jewels to their rightful place. Take control of 3 uniquely gifted warriors to embark on a quest in this strategy roguelike. Using their unique abilities in synergistic ways to tackle the monsters that stand between them and the jewel

Take control of 4 uniquely gifted warriors to embark on a quest in this strategy roguelike.

Terrira, the druid from the Nature Tribe. Digging holes around Octodie plants found all over the labyrinths to trap enemies and weaken them before capture.

Frostian, the warrior from the Protection Tribe. Armed with a magical shield that can block all normal attacks and push enemies back.

Eon is an old and wise healer from the Tribe of Immortality. Casting a bubble of healing around him, any ally within his bubble's range heals all their wounds. At the same time, it damages any enemy who comes close.

Ivor is a scout from the Premonition Tribe. His crossbow shoots faster than the eye can see and melts any rock or metal.

With 4 unique regions with countless procedurally generated labyrinths to explor,e use all the characters and their abilities in fun and unique ways to defeat the Monster of every region to collect all the jewels.

Upgrade the characters' abilities at the shopkeeper in the fortress, where you can regroup after every run.

Switch between characters in real-time at any time during gameplay. Pickup horns to call upon your allies to help build your winning strategies.

  • Processor: Intel i5-750 /AMD Phenom II X4-945
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
